svg.text: Robosen Tangible Coding Block System — Config Dock Programming Flow
PHASE 1: J1 AUTO-DETECT, READ-SYNC & UI PREVIEW
PHASE 2: 0xCF PACKET TX & BLOCK FLASH WRITE

g.text: Port Mode Lock forces Mode 1A (CONFIG) while docked
Rx [0xCF, 0x81, ActID, Param, CRC, 0x55] -> Syncs UI
0x01 Walk Fwd | 0x02 Back | 0x03 Turn L | 0x04 Turn R
Shows current Icon, Parameter & Config dock state
Reaches block on IN Pin 3 (PD6 UART1) OR OUT Pin 4 (PD0 SW)
Block is ready for 0xAA / 0xBB chain runs immediately
Sent via PD5 (USART1 TX) or PD0 (SW TX) to match J1 dock
Silent Drop (No NAK / No Red LED Flash)
Bad CRC-8, wrong length or missing 0x55 footer discarded
Existing 0x08003FC0 flash stays intact; no ACK transmitted
Redraws E-Ink showing stored Action Icon + Param
Undock from J1 (1200ms timeout clears Mode 1A)
Snap into J2 Chain for Run Execution (Mode 1B)
1. Write returns false if neither TX direction yields 0x06
3. If absent > 1200ms: exits Mode 1A -> Mode 1B or Mode 2
• Both IN (PD6 UART1) & OUT (PD0 bit-bang) accept 0xCF.
• Action ID 0xEE configures unified PCB as Smart End Block.
